newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up eight cents on foreign demand.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up eight cents on foreign demand.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price closed up eight cents at 14.27 ringgit ($5.76) a kg, extending its rebound on the back of foreign demand, traders said.
Helped by overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), the market has recouped all of its 16-cent loss incurred on Wednesday.
Turnover was 123 tonnes, up from 109 on Thursday, with strong buying seen from European and Japanese interests.
Traders said they expected further upside given the renewed foreign demand. The local price premium over LME narrowed to $15 a tonne from $70 previously.
